parsed.post: New best: 1.0139 BPB. Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 successfully improved convergence by increasing optimizer steps within the 5m budget. DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.06 appear to be a strong stable baseline. Next: testing if slightly higher WARMUP_RATIO or WEIGHT_DECAY can further refine this configuration.
parsed.description: Testing if increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 improves stabilization and convergence for the depth=6, batch=262k config.
